events.title: Thrive -  Sheridan EDGE's Signature Entrepreneurship Program (Fall'26)
events.excerpt: Sheridan EDGE’s signature program for Sheridan students to develop venture ideas through 1:1 mentorship sessions with experienced mentors.
events.description:
Sheridan EDGE’s signature program for Sheridan students to develop venture ideas through 1:1 mentorship sessions with experienced mentors.
This program is exclusively for Sheridan students & alumni only.
Free for Sheridan Students & Alumni | 2 months (7sessions) | Hybrid program
Thrive is an application-based hybrid program where Sheridan students develop business ideas and build practical entrepreneurial skills. Through one-on-one mentorship, participants strengthen the foundations of their ventures by refining ideas and building clear business models.
Please review application process
to apply.
Registering on Eventbrite alone does not complete your application. To apply, please submit your application using the link found in the
Application Process
section below.
Who should apply
Sheridan students or alumni who want to:
Develop an entrepreneurial mindset
Refine business concepts and models
Create social impact through their ideas
Build strong business plans and conduct market research
Accelerate the development of their ventures
What
to expect
Weekly one-on-one virtual mentorship sessions with a mentor
Access to additional industry mentors when specialized guidance is needed
Online resources and tools through Google Classroom
Final pitch presentation
Benefits to Students
Personalized mentorship:
One-on-one guidance from experienced mentors to refine ideas and navigate challenges.
Hands-on learning:
Practical activities focused on building business plans and developing minimum viable products (MVPs).
Networking opportunities:
Connections with peers, industry experts, and faculty advisors.
CCR credit and certification:
Recognition through a certificate and Co-Curricular Record (CCR).
Launch support:
Structured guidance that helps move ideas from concept to execution.
Learning modules:
Free access to entrepreneurship and venture development resources.
Entrepreneurial community:
Join a network of aspiring entrepreneurs and changemakers.
Coworking access
: Pre-approved access to Sheridan EDGE coworking spaces.
Skill development:
Opportunities to strengthen pitching and sales skills
Application Process
Applications open every term (Winter, Spring/Summer, Fall) and are reviewed on a rolling basis until all spots are filled.
Application Open Date:
4
th August 2026
(Monday)
Application Close Date:
15th
September 2026
(Tuesday)
Selection Criteria:
Idea clarity:
The idea addresses a clear problem or opportunity.
Impact:
The venture demonstrates social impact and aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
Application quality:
The application is complete and clearly written.
Commitment:
Applicants commit to seven mentorship sessions and weekly program work.
Motivation:
Applicants demonstrate strong interest in completing the program.
Please
submit
the complete application form to be considered.
To apply for Fall 2026 Cohort,
click here
Hosts
Sheridan
EDGE
EDGE is a vibrant community of people who believe entrepreneurship can create lasting change in society. It’s also a hub for impact entrepreneurs to grow their ventures, collaborate and develop new skills. Impact entrepreneurs, talented students, experienced faculty and like-minded community and industry collaborators work together at EDGE to amplify social and economic impact. We’re an integral part of Sheridan’s Academic & Industry Integrations (aii) division that connects education and industry to empower learner success, strengthen partnerships and advance academic excellence. events.description:
Connect 1:1 with an industry mentor for individualized guidance and support
Join us at the Ask EDGE Mentor Pop-up Session and connect one-on-one with an experienced mentor who’s here to support your entrepreneurship journey.
Our mentor will help you level up in whatever stage you’re at — from exploring entrepreneurship to refining your business model or scaling your venture. You’ll get personalized guidance tailored to your specific level of support, including learning and development, career readiness, idea development, business planning, and growth strategies.This is your space to ask questions, get guidance, and start building something that matters to you. No experience needed — just bring your questions and walk away with clarity. All Sheridan students are welcome.
How it works
- you can join us for a mentorship session either in-person or virtually
For in-person
session:
Step 1: Register for the session through this page.
Step 2: On the day of the session, arrive at H153 (Sheridan’s Davis Campus) by 11:00 am to secure your 20-minute slot.
For virtual
session:
Step 1: To join virtually,
book a time here
and receive your meeting link.
Sessions run from
11:00 am to
3
:00 pm
and spots are assigned on a first-come, first-served basis. Bring your questions, ideas, or challenges and get focused, actionable next steps.
Who should attend
?
Sheridan students who want to:
Explore entrepreneurship and business development
Get feedback on an idea or business model
Build professional skills through one-on-one mentorship
Learn how Sheridan EDGE can support their goals
Why should you attend?
Explore entrepreneurship and discover how it can fit into your life.
Sharpen leadership, communication and intrapreneurial skills.
Get one-on-one mentorship to develop, refine, and validate your idea.
Learn how to structure a business plan using Sheridan EDGE’s template.
Engage in a focused session with a business coach.
Get guidance to grow or scale your business.

events.title: Ask EDGE - Using Entrepreneurial Thinking to Land Your Next Role
events.excerpt: Join us  for an interactive session to discover how entrepreneurial strategies can transform your approach to landing your next role.
events.description:
Join us  for an interactive session to discover how entrepreneurial strategies can transform your approach to landing your next role.
As part of Job Search Week at Sheridan, held by Career-integrated learning, join Nadine Sinno, Manager of Student Engagement at Sheridan EDGE and Fatima Gould, mentor at ASK EDGE and CEO of Green Curtain, for an interactive session to discover how entrepreneurial strategies can transform your approach to landing your next role. Learn to position yourself as the best candidate and craft an elevator pitch that stands out. Whether you're job hunting or exploring entrepreneurship, this practical session will help you to understand how to communicate your unique value with confidence.
Read more
